# Enable Secure, Data-Driven Innovation

Protect your data while putting it to work. Fortanix empowers you to safely leverage your data— wherever it is—to drive business innovation and improve experiences, while preventing data exposure.

[![Request a Demo](https://no-cache.hubspot.com/cta/default/3435228/b02137cd-d258-4121-ba58-7dd5c7369ed5.png)](https://cta-redirect.hubspot.com/cta/redirect/3435228/b02137cd-d258-4121-ba58-7dd5c7369ed5)

![enable-secure-data-driven-innovation](https://www.fortanix.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.aglty.io%2Ffortanix%2Fsolutions%2Fuse-case%2Fenable-secure-data-driven-innovation%2FFORT_DataDrivenInnovation_Header.webp&w=3840&q=75)

#### Empower Teams to Securely Use Data

Equip teams across the enterprise to securely use the data they need and build smarter AI models to achieve their business objectives. Maintain control over security measures and compliance, with the ability to control data access, enforce policies, and prevent malicious tampering with data or intellectual property.

![Empower Teams to Securely Use Data](https://www.fortanix.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.aglty.io%2Ffortanix%2Fsolutions%2Fuse-case%2Fenable-secure-data-driven-innovation%2Ffeature_01.webp&w=3840&q=75)

#### Grow Your Business Faster

Security concerns shouldn't slow your time to market. Fortanix helps you accelerate product innovation by encrypting and tokenizing sensitive data and making it safe to use in AI and cloud-based tools.

![Grow Your Business Faster](https://www.fortanix.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.aglty.io%2Ffortanix%2Fsolutions%2Fuse-case%2Fenable-secure-data-driven-innovation%2FFORT_DataDrivenInnovation_Feature2.webp&w=3840&q=75)

#### Unlock Your Data’s Potential

Improve outcomes, innovate products, and personalize experiences with Fortanix Data Tokenization. Apply Format Preserving Encryption at data creation or ingestion to make security an attribute of the data and prevent data exposure across workflows and applications.

[Learn More](https://www.fortanix.com/platform/data-security-manager/data-tokenization)

![Unlock Your Data’s Potential](https://www.fortanix.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.aglty.io%2Ffortanix%2Fsolutions%2Fuse-case%2Fenable-secure-data-driven-innovation%2FFORT_DataDrivenInnovation_Feature3.webp&w=3840&q=75)

#### Securely Share Data

Monetize your data through collaboration with third parties in a secure environment. Bring the data you need to a confidential compute environment and eliminate the risk of exposing sensitive data.

![Securely Share Data](https://www.fortanix.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.aglty.io%2Ffortanix%2Fsolutions%2Fuse-case%2Fenable-secure-data-driven-innovation%2FFORT_DataDrivenInnovation_Feature4.webp&w=3840&q=75)

#### Keep AI Models Secure

Secure the intellectual property of your AI model. Fortanix Confidential AI allows you to publish the algorithm in a secure enclave to limit the visibility into your secret sauce. Build richer models and protect your IP.

[Learn More](https://www.fortanix.com/solutions/use-case/confidential-ai)

![diagram 4](https://www.fortanix.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fcdn.aglty.io%2Ffortanix%2Fsolutions%2Fuse-case%2Fenable-secure-data-driven-innovation%2FFORT_DataDrivenInnovation_Feature5.webp&w=3840&q=75)

![slider background Image](https://cdn.aglty.io/fortanix/solutions/use-case/enable-secure-data-driven-innovation/FORT_DeataDrivenInnovation_Quote.webp)

> “AI is foundational to the initiatives we've launched to tangibly transform pharmaceutical research and development, but models require extremely large amounts of data that often contain sensitive or personal information. Confidential Computing from Fortanix and NVIDIA essentially alleviates those privacy and security concerns while also improving model accuracy, which will prove to be a win-win situation for the entire industry.”

Hiroki Makiguchi

CTO at Xeureka
